fields.implementation_summary: Extended rule-api EntityFeedbackStore (on the completed gate c7542933 core store) with author-aware ingestion (FeedbackAuthorKind human/privileged-agent + IngestAuthor with normalized identity and privileged-agent id requirement), ingest_usage/ingest_rating persisting author metadata on URN-keyed NDJSON events, backfill of agent_or_user_id from the author, and a baseline RetentionPolicy (max_age / max_events per kind) via apply_retention/apply_retention_at with idempotent chronological pruning. load_core now preserves stored timestamps and author metadata while keeping rating-invariant validation.

fields.implementation_summary: Extended rule-api EntityFeedbackStore (on gate c7542933 core store) with author-aware ingestion (FeedbackAuthorKind human/privileged-agent + IngestAuthor with normalized identity and privileged-agent id requirement), ingest_usage persisting author metadata, and a baseline RetentionPolicy (max_age / max_events per kind) via apply_retention/apply_retention_at with idempotent chronological pruning. load_core preserves stored timestamps and author metadata. Review fix: ingest_rating now takes a raw EntityRatingSubmission and backfills agent_or_user_id from the author BEFORE validation, enforcing only the session-requires-actor direction (an authenticated author is always the actor). Note-kind resolution factored into a shared resolve_note_kind helper.

RECONCILE 2026-07-12: this code migrated out of rule-api into the first-class feedback-api crate (design fb6aa078, ring rework 5d4078fa). rule-api::feedback is now a pub use feedback_api::* shim. All ingestion/retention/backfill logic and tests survived intact; feedback_store.rs is still being extended for FeedbackEntry inbox + ring edges under the migration ticket.
